title: Dr.Jart+ signs Katseye’s Yoonchae Jeung as first North America Brand Ambassador
summary: South Korean singer and Katseye girl group member, Yoonchae Jeung, is the new face of Dr.Jart+’s Premium BB Cream, building on the Estée Lauder Companies-owned brand’s ‘legacy’ of collaborating with Korea’s ‘most exciting artists’
